name: Nick
source: Nick and his friends Paul and Josh are blood bound under Continue?'s banner. They are inseparable and typically found wreaking general havoc by reenacting the '80s and '90s arcade beat-em-ups they love so dearly. Nick generally seems to be the most well-behaved of the group, his steady and reliable nature balancing out his friends' mischievous streaks.
